body:
NARROW REPAIR MAP after tracing the checked input boundary. No core or acquire public-type edit is necessary if the chief accepts compiler-boundary refusal. NarrativeCompilerInput.of already owns the only public construction path for the checked compiler input and accumulates DomainError values before storing it.

A local validateProviderCall can reject promptTemplateVersion.exists(trim.isEmpty) at every carrier that can survive or influence compilation: input provenance.calls; every proposal receipt.call; each local PropositionEvidence.provenance.receipts; each chart.provenance.receipts; and each chart alignment ClaimMeta provenance.calls. Separately reject every CriticFinding.note.exists(trim.isEmpty) while traversing allBundles. The chart carriers matter because NarrativeCompilation retains MentionGraph, whose checked charts retain chart provenance and alignment ClaimMeta.

Acceptance evidence should show NarrativeCompilerInput.of returns InvalidInput for blank base call, proposal call, retained chart call, and finding note, with a normal nonblank sibling accepted; then no NarrativeCompilation can retain Some empty. This remains inside the reserved document compiler and suite paths. If the chief intends a repository-wide invariant on the upstream public types instead, that requires explicit wider path or ADR scope.
